subject.title: fix(gateway): avoid full-registry sort in tasks.list for O(n log n) perf gain

question: Should maintainers land this PR as a standalone partial optimization, ask the author to extend it into the full bounded-selection fix, or prefer the fuller related PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101716?
rationale: The submitted patch is technically coherent and now has benchmark proof, but it intentionally does less than the canonical issue asks and overlaps with another open candidate branch that is more complete but not merged or proof-cleared.

options.title: Prefer a complete bounded-selection fix
options.body: Use a complete candidate, such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102202 after proof is accepted, to close the canonical issue and then supersede this partial PR if it is no longer needed.

options.title: Land this as partial only
options.body: Merge this PR only if maintainers explicitly want the smaller pre-sort removal while keeping the canonical issue open for the remaining handler full-sort cost.

options.title: Ask this author to extend
options.body: Request that this PR add bounded top-K selection and equivalence coverage so it can become the canonical fix itself.

recommendation.title: Prefer a complete bounded-selection fix
recommendation.body: Use a complete candidate, such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102202 after proof is accepted, to close the canonical issue and then supersede this partial PR if it is no longer needed.
